title: Upcoming Fleisch virtual workshops
summary: The Herbert Fleisch Workshops bring together excellent international investigators and young and mid-career scientists working in bone and cartilage research.
bodyHtml:
The Herbert Fleisch Workshops are designed to bring together excellent international investigators and young and mid-career scientists working in bone and cartilage research, for vigorous data discussion and networking.

On 19 (Tuesday) and 21 (Thursday) of April 2022, the IFMRS will host two free workshops led by international experts in the field of musculoskeletal research:

Bone Health in Weight Extremes - Tuesday 19 April, 18:00 (UTC)

Overcoming challenges for musculoskeletal health in low and middle-income countries - Thursday 21 April, 7:00 (UTC)

Register here to attend one or both workshops.
